name: DEV DoF Probe
summary: DEV ONLY - NOT FOR UPLOAD. Switches environments that turn a hand-installed DoF probe shader on.
description: DEV ONLY - NOT FOR UPLOAD. Never publish this mod. A top-bar button cycles the rendering environment through four copies of the current base climate whose light.latitude carries a mode (+ 2 pi per mode) for the probe shader in shader_files/ (tilt-shift, depth of field, shallow depth of field, debug). The shader must be copied into the game install by hand. Logs [SQDOF] lines. See plans/square_photo_dof_probe/TESTING.md.
